text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe! It's Manhattan Cafe! Even 
after crossing the line, her eyes are 
fixed on the far horizon!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Just where is she headed!? And just how 
strong will she become!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Couldn't catch up... huh. 
Though... you couldn't get away either...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I don't like it. Acting as if she doesn't 
even see me chasing desperately after 
her...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Still, I suppose we're in the same boat. 
As long as we're running in the same 
direction, the gap won't close.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's a long way away, isn't it... Which is 
exactly why it's worth striving for.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Tachyon-san...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"The experiment is temporarily concluded. 
From here on, there is no Plan A or B. 
Everything comes together—"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: A new plan begins. Namely, "Plan C."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Plan... C.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, intertwining like a spiral, 
influencing each other, and accelerating 
even further."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Join me, Cafe. In this—magnificent 
experiment."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ......Right...... I'll... think about it.

Without even coming to the Winner's 
Circle, Manhattan Cafe stood motionless, 
staring out past the track.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Because of you... they left. My "friend".

Did I scare them away by calling out? When 
I apologized honestly...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: That is... not the case.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Because of you... she has gotten so fast 
that I can't catch up... That's what it 
means.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Yes—evolution...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The higher my ideals become, the faster my 
"friend" gets...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The more walls I overcome... the further 
it beckons me. Whispering, "You can go 
even further, can't you?"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
If I were alone, I surely would have 
caught up by now. Caught up... and ended 
right there. However—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Even now, I am still looking up at the 
sky... Looking up and up at a skyscraper 
whose summit remains out of sight...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Because you elevated... my "friend." 
Because you... elevated me.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
So high up............ it's out of 
reach............

What is this "friend"? I felt as though I 
had finally reached the threshold of 
understanding.
That is neither good nor evil. Because—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
You can get even faster, right... 
"Friend"...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
And we can keep chasing after it, can't 
we? All of us...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: They are no longer just my 'friend.'

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
She's the girl we both envisioned... I 
want to pursue her together with you, to 
the ends of the earth.

Looking up at the sky side by side—we 
reflected on the vastness and nobility of 
our shared goal.
